overview: Kazakhstan's green city at the foot of the Tian Shan mountains: cable cars to alpine meadows, glacier-fed lakes and big parks, at good value and a short flight from Delhi.
fit: Good for both; mountain day trips involve driving and altitude up to ~2,500 m.
season: May–September is warm and green (20–30°C in the city, cooler in the mountains). Winter is snowy, with Shymbulak ski resort open.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Almaty (1-stop via Delhi; Air Astana flies Delhi–Almaty)

gettingAround: Yandex Go cabs are cheap; hire a driver for mountain day trips.

todo.title: Kok Tobe cable car
todo.why: Hilltop park with a small zoo and rides

foodTips: Vegetarian takes some effort; carry snacks and look for Indian restaurants.
save: Cabs via Yandex Go are cheap
Book Charyn Canyon as a group tour
safety: Mountain weather changes fast; carry layers
kids: Kok Tobe's rides and zoo suit the 4-year-old
Keep Charyn only if everyone likes long drives

days.plan: Panfilov Park; Green Bazaar; Kok Tobe

visa: Indian citizens have been allowed visa-free stays of up to 14 days in Kazakhstan. Check the current rule on the Kazakhstan embassy website before booking.
